pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I MADE SOME OKAYU WITH POTATOES TODAY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: OH, WORKING HARD THERE, OTSU? BE CAREFUL

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: Otsu's all happy because she can be with Master more since he can't fight.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WILL YOU NOT EAT? IT WAS DELICIOUS. A bit salty though...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DON'T WANT ANY RIGHT NOW.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: A SINGLE STROKE OF THE SWORD WITH EVERYTHING HE HAD FROM BEHIND... EVEN THE YOSHIOKA COULDN'T CARE ABOUT HOW THEY LOOK TO OTHERS.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: STAY HERE A WHILE AND RECUPERATE.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: OTSU WILL STAY HERE BY YOUR SIDE.
